COMMUNITY
AGRICULTURE

Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) is a way of purchasing food that forms a direct connection between you, the eater and us, the farmers.  CSA is an opportunity to know and have a relationship with the people who grow your food and form a connection to the land it’s grown on.  We’re real people and would like to share our beautiful farm with you!  As we journey together through the seasons, you’ll experience the adventure of cooking and eating fresh, vibrant vegetables harvested at their peak of ripeness.  With CSA, you become part of the face and story of the food we grow and the food you eat.  You become part of the “big picture!”  

We offer CSA delivery to Minneapolis & St. Paul, MN; the greater Madison, WI area; and our local area from May to December. You will find a variety of share offerings & flexible payment plans to choose from.   We support the community with great, organic food and the community supports us!

W
hile our focus is on growing vegetables, animals are also an important part of our farm and help us maintain hillside pasture areas not suitable for vegetable production. While they may not realize they have an important job, we know that without their grazing rotations through our hillside pastures, the land could quickly be overtaken by undesirable ‘weed’ trees and invasive species that would choke out the rich pasture grasses. They also help us by fertilizing the land which keeps the pastures rich and flourishing and prevents erosion on the hillsides. We choose to raise our animals in an environment where they can exhibit their natural behaviors and characteristics. We treat them gently and with respect so they do not live in fear of human touch or presence. This creates a much more pleasant environment for them to live in and allows us to work amongst them more safely.

Read More about Animal Husbandry at Harmony Valley Farm
100 % GRASS FED BEEF
Our beef cattle are rotationally grazed on our rich hillside pastures in the spring, summer and fall. During the winter months we feed certified organic hay from our land that we put up during the summer. We maintain herd health by providing them with a healthy environment, rich pastures and a calm lifestyle. During the summer months we control flies with a blend of certified organic sunflower oil and citronella oil. Both our cattle and our pastures are certified organic.
View Share Options
PASTURED PORK
Our pigs take full advantage of their days to explore the wooded hillsides, enjoy a snack in the wild apple orchards, create a nice mud wallow and then return to their home base at the end of the day. We seldom see them during the day when they are out and about on their adventures, but they always make their way home in the evening just in time to enjoy a load of vegetable scraps from the packing shed! Some of their favorite vegetable selections include spinach, tomatoes and beets. In addition to their foraged treasures and vegetable scraps, we supplement their diet with a blend of certified organic grain.
View Share Options

A
ll of our processed meat products are certified organic and are free of synthetic nitrites/nitrates. Our smoked, uncured ham and bacon do contain celery juice powder which has natural nitrites/nitrates. These products should remain frozen until you are ready to use them. Once thawed, we recommend you consume them within 5 days as they will not store as long as products cured with conventional nitrates. These products should be stored in the refrigerator.

The term “uncured,” used to describe our bacon and smoked hams, can be confusing. The traditional process for curing meats uses synthetic nitrates/nitrites and is done as a means of preserving as well as flavoring the meat. Meat that is processed in accordance to organic standards does not use synthetic nitrates/nitrites for preservation and thus must be labeled as “uncured.” The meat is tumbled in a brine solution containing organic seasonings and ingredients to impart flavor prior to being smoked.

WHAT IS A CSA?

It is sometimes described as a vegetable co-op, a weekly box delivery, a vegetable of the week club, or a produce subscription program, but we refer to it as Community Supported Agriculture, CSA. Families or individuals join our farm to receive weekly or bi-weekly deliveries of the fantastic organic produce we grow here at Harmony Valley Farm. Whatever is ripe and delicious for the week, goes into the box: washed, chilled and carefully packed. Then we deliver it to a neighborhood near you, if you live in or near Madison, Cross Plains, Richland Center, Viroqua, Onalaska or La Crosse, Wisconsin or the Twin Cities. The variety and quality - ask our members - is unmatched! We support the community with great, organic food and the community supports us!

WHAT MAKES OUR CSA UNIQUE?

• Offerings of Certified Organic Vegetable & Meat Shares
• Fresh, nutritious, clean produce with convenient delivery to your neighborhood
• Long delivery season from May through December
• Confident, skillful growers with over 40 years of organic farming experience
• A farmer who is also a professionally trained Chef
• Simple & tasty recipes and storage & use tips with every delivery
• Fun On-Farm Events--Come see for yourself!
• Flexible share & payment options to best fit your needs
• A vigorous farm food safety program with third party certification
• A hard-working & respected professional farm crew that is paid a fair & living wage
• Stewards of the environment providing pollinator-friendly, beneficial habitat to foster bio-diversity

WE STILL HAVE FLEX PLAN (YOU CHOOSE YOUR SCHEDULED WEEKS) AND AUTUMN SHARES (LAST 4 SHARE BOXES IN NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER) AVAILABLE FOR THE 2026 CSA SEASON

Our vegetable shares are designed to meet the needs of a family of four. Take time to thoughtfully consider which shares will best meet the needs and eating habits of your household.

We are happy to partner with FairShare CSA Coalition. If you would like to use SNAP to pay for your CSA shares or see if you qualify for financial assistance paying for your CSA shares, take a look at their website: https://www.csacoalition.org/partner-shares. They are happy to help you out if you have any questions about financial assistance.

WEEKLY VEGETABLE SHARE
30 boxes, delivered weekly May though October and every other week November and December.
Total cost is $1,215.00 (please note shares delivered to Lunds & Byerlys store locations incur a $2.50 per box fee)
••••
This share will give you the full seasonal experience from early spring through our peak summer season and concludes with our late fall season selections. Spring selections may include overwintered spinach & parsnips, asparagus, ramps, salad greens & spring radishes. See our PEAK SEASON description below for our summer vegetable selections. Late season boxes may include a variety of root crops (carrots, parsnips, beets, turnips, celeriac), cabbage, onions, garlic, sweet potatoes & winter squash. The weekly share is the most economical option per box. If a weekly box is too much for you, consider finding another household to share the box with or consider our every-other-week or flex shares below.
Sign Me Up!
MOST POPULAR
EVERY OTHER WEEK (EOW) VEGETABLE SHARE
17 boxes, delivered every other week May to December
Total cost is $726.75 (please note shares delivered to Lunds & Byerlys store locations incur a $2.50 per box fee)
••••
This share includes the same seasonal selections we pack in the weekly box, but delivered less frequently. EOW members pick up shares on either GREEN or BROWN weeks. Delivery calendars can be found below. Please indicate your preference on your sign-up form. We are unable to change your delivery dates mid-season to accommodate vacations or other special occasions. If you would like the convenience of choosing and changing your delivery dates, please consider our FLEX plan.
Sign Me Up!
PEAK SEASON SHARE
20 boxes, delivered weekly Mid-June through October
Total price is $875.00 (please note shares delivered to Lunds & Byerlys store locations incur a $2.50 per box fee)
••••
This shorter season share features summer produce grown during the peak of our season. Box contents may include summer greens (such as Swiss chard), green beans, cucumbers, sweet peppers, tomatoes, sweet corn, melons, summer squash and more.
Sign Me Up!
VEGETABLE FLEX PLAN
Delivered May-December on the weeks of your choice. 10 box minimum purchase
Total price per box is $43.75 (please note shares delivered to Lunds & Byerlys store locations incur a $2.50 per box fee) ••••
This share will allow you to choose which weeks you want to receive a delivery. Please use the delivery calendar available on our website to select preliminary delivery dates from May-December. Send this schedule to the farm along with your sign-up form. You will be able to make changes to your schedule throughout the season as long as you let us know by noon on Tuesday the week of the change. This option is also available for those who sign up part way into the season. This is a popular selection for members in smaller households or those that travel frequently for work or summer vacations. This has also become a popular gift for college students.
